definition: A game state where both junglers opt to [path](/term/pathing) on one side (bot/top) of the map only. Split maps often form as a result of vertical jungling, creating a well-defined [strongside](/term/strongside) and [weakside](/term/weakside). Because split maps incentivize junglers to focus on only one side of the map while ignoring the other, side lanes that benefit from increased jungle presence benefit more from a successful split map.
